_comment: Single source of truth for the launcher. Add a new program by appending one object below — no code changes needed. 'group' and 'category' are free text; the sidebar groups/orders them by first appearance here. mode: 'web' = served on localhost and embedded as an iframe tab; 'cli' = opens a terminal with 'commands'. icon = any Tabler outline icon name (https://tabler.io/icons). Optional 'backend' = a Python file inside 'folder' that the hub starts on demand (POST /api/start-backend) when the program's frontend cannot reach its API.
